description: A UCC lien search report: a list of Uniform Commercial Code filings found against a debtor search, followed by the detail record of one selected filing

report_provider.description: The company that produced the search report, from the header or footer

result_count.description: The number of UCC search results stated in the 'UCC Search Results (n)' heading

search_results.description: Every result block in the UCC Search Results table, in printed order, including those on the second page. The same document number can appear in more than one result under different debtor names; list each result block separately and do not merge them. The array length should equal the count in the 'UCC Search Results (n)' heading

debtor_name.description: The debtor name printed in bold above the filing description. Only some results print one; leave it empty when the result has no bold name

filing_description.description: The filing description in the debtor column, e.g. 'UCC FINANCE STATEMENT FILED'

debtor_address.description: The debtor address printed in the debtor column, on one line

document_number.description: The value after 'DOC NUMBER:', as printed including any masking characters

filing_state.description: The two-letter filing state in the Filing column

date_filed.description: The filing date in the Filing column, as YYYY-MM-DD

secured_party_name.description: The creditor (secured party) name in the Creditor column

secured_party_address.description: The creditor address in the Creditor column, on one line

collateral.description: The collateral description following the 'COLLATERAL:' label; leave it empty when the label has no text after it

filing_detail.description: The detailed record of one filing in the 'Additional Data Sources - UCC Report' section

original_document_number.description: The value after 'Original Document Nr.:', as printed

original_date_filed.description: The value after 'Original Date Filed:', as YYYY-MM-DD

filing_state_name.description: The full state name after 'Filing State Name:'

debtor_parties.description: Each row of the Debtor Parties table

address.description: The debtor's full mailing address on one line, as printed

secured_parties.description: Each row of the Secured Parties table

name.description: The secured party's name, as printed

address.description: The secured party's full mailing address on one line, as printed

events.description: Each filing event in the Events section

type_of_filing.description: The value after 'Type Of Filing:', with whitespace and line breaks collapsed to single spaces

date_filed.description: The value after 'Date Filed:', as YYYY-MM-DD

document_number.description: The value after 'Document Number:', as printed
